correctness.rationale: For the exact F3 curve, q(x)=x³+2x²+1 is irreducible and supplies exactly three geometric simple poles. Standard genus/p-rank formulas give genus four and ordinary 3-rank four. Exact enumeration gives N1..N4=(6,12,42,132), accounting for one point at each rational pole and three points over infinity. Newton identities and genus-four functional equation uniquely yield L_X=(1+T+T²+3T³+9T⁴)². The hyperelliptic genus-two quintic has a reproduced Bézout squarefreeness certificate and (N1,N2)=(5,11), forcing L_C equal to the quartic. Tate proves the F3 isogeny; irreducibility mod 2 of the quartic reciprocal proves simple factor; coefficient modulo 3 proves ordinarity. An exact stdlib checker reproduces the computations and redundant n5..8 counts.
